toegepas.blok: Party plekke is nat en party is droog
toegepas.voor: Reën val nie oral op die aarde dieselfde hoeveelheid nie.
toegepas.na: Daar val nie oral op die aarde ewe veel reën nie.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Reën val dieselfde hoeveelheid' is a wooden construction; 'daar val ewe veel reën' is the natural Afrikaans form with the same meaning.
toegepas.fout: 'Reën val nie ... dieselfde hoeveelheid nie' is a wooden construction with an object-like amount hanging off an intransitive verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The existential 'daar val ... ewe veel reën' is the natural Afrikaans form and says exactly the same.

toegepas.voor: 'n Mens kan reën meet en die maat daarvoor is millimeter.
toegepas.na: 'n Mens kan reën meet, en die maat daarvoor is millimeter.
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two sentences with their own subject and verb, so a comma goes before it.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb ('n Mens kan meet / die maat is).
toegepas.rede_keurder: AWS 2017 requires the comma here and nothing else changes.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'n millimeter hoog met water bedek' is awkward; 'met 'n millimeter water bedek' is the natural phrasing and leaves the protected 'n plat oppervlak' intact.
toegepas.fout: ''n millimeter hoog met water bedek' is stiff and makes the reader stumble.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'met 'n millimeter water bedek' is the natural phrasing, means the same depth, and leaves the protected ''n plat oppervlak' untouched.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'saam' is vague here; 'bymekaargetel' says clearly that the millimetres are added up.
toegepas.fout: 'saam' is loose about what is done with the millimetres.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'bymekaargetel' states the adding-up plainly for a Grade 6 reader without changing the claim.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'daardie plek' points back to a place that the block never names.
toegepas.fout: 'daardie plek' points back to a place the block never names.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'op 'n plek' removes the dangling reference and keeps the meaning.

toegepas.rede_vinder: With a countable noun after 'soorte', Afrikaans normally uses the plural ('twee soorte kaarte'); this is the block heading, not the lesson title.
toegepas.fout: After 'twee soorte' a countable noun normally takes the plural in Afrikaans.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Twee soorte kaarte' is the expected form in a block heading and changes nothing else.

toegepas.voor: hoe warm plekke is en 'n reënvalkaart
toegepas.na: hoe warm plekke is, en 'n reënvalkaart
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two sentences with their own subject and verb, so a comma goes before it.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb (Temperatuurkaarte wys / 'n reënvalkaart wys).
toegepas.rede_keurder: AWS 2017 requires the comma here; the change does not overlap change 10.

toegepas.rede_vinder: In this kind of clause Afrikaans normally uses the existential 'daar' ('hoeveel reën daar val').
toegepas.fout: 'hoeveel reën val' without 'daar' reads thin in this clause.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The existential 'daar' is the natural Afrikaans form here and the meaning is unchanged.

toegepas.voor: lees elke skakering in sy eie sleutel op
toegepas.na: kyk in elke kaart se eie sleutel wat die skakering beteken
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'oplees' means to read aloud, and 'sy' could refer to the shade rather than the map; the new wording says what the learner does and whose key it is.
toegepas.fout: 'oplees' means to read aloud, so the verb is wrong, and 'sy eie sleutel' could point to the shade instead of the map.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The proposal names the right action and makes clear it is each map's own key, with no new fact.

toegepas.voor: dat warm nie ook nat beteken nie
toegepas.na: dat 'n warm plek nie noodwendig nat is nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: Read literally, 'warm beteken nie ook nat nie' says warm never means wet, which the Amazon example in the same block contradicts; the intended point is that warm does not imply wet.
toegepas.fout: 'warm nie ook nat beteken nie' is compressed and a young reader can take it as 'warm places are not wet', which the Amazon in the same block contradicts.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'nie noodwendig nat is nie' says exactly what 'beteken nie' implies logically, so the intended meaning is kept and made unambiguous.

toegepas.voor: Lees Suid-Afrika self op die reënvalkaart af
toegepas.na: Kyk na Suid-Afrika self op die reënvalkaart
toegepas.rede_vinder: You read values off a map, not a country; 'kyk na Suid-Afrika' is the natural phrasing.
toegepas.fout: One reads values off a map, not a country; 'Lees Suid-Afrika af' is unidiomatic.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Kyk na Suid-Afrika self op die reënvalkaart' is natural, and the next sentence's 'Volgens die sleutel' still carries the map reading.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'in 'n skakering staan' is unidiomatic; a part of a map 'het' a shade.
toegepas.fout: 'staan in 'n donkerder skakering' is an unidiomatic way to say a map area is shaded darker.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'het 'n donkerder skakering as' is the plain natural form with the same comparison.

laat_vaar.blok: Party plekke is nat en party is droog
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'een enkele jaar' echoes English 'a single year'; 'in een jaar' says the same and still contrasts with 'in 'n hele jaar'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'een enkele jaar' is acceptable Afrikaans and its emphasis carries the contrast with 'n hele jaar' in the next sentences, so the cut loses something for no clear gain.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Three sentences in a row open with 'Die kaart'; a pronoun here improves the flow and the reference stays clear.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Only two sentences open with 'Die kaart', the repetition is clear for a Grade 6 reader, and 'Dit' is a lateral move.

na_skrywer.voor: Hoeveel reën op 'n plek val en in millimeter gemeet word.
na_skrywer.na: Die hoeveelheid reën wat op 'n plek val, gemeet in millimeter.
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: In the current definition the subject of 'gemeet word' is unclear; the new form says plainly that the amount is measured in millimetres. If this definition is shared across lessons, it should go to the writer.
na_skrywer.fout: The 'en ... gemeet word' clause is loosely joined, so what is measured in millimetres is unclear.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: This is a glossary definition, so a rewording beyond a plain spelling or grammar fix belongs to the writer for every lesson at once.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.blok: Party plekke is nat en party is droog
vlae.teks: Die Amasone in Suid-Amerika is een van daardie baie nat plekke.
vlae.rede: 'Die Amasone' on its own usually means the river; the lesson means the region or rainforest (also in 'Twee soorte kaart langs mekaar'). It is not changed because the intended term, and whether it matches the video or other lessons, is a content decision.
